rule: No claim is promoted to customer/pilot/impact evidence without primary artifacts and the repository evidence gate.

claims.missing_primary_fact: reachable pre-freeze decision with measurable improvement opportunity
claims.best_evidence: quantity owner + contractor planner + reconstructed recent service
claims.falsifier: quantity fixed before useful signals or current workflow already adequate
existing tool/process solves same decision adequately

claims.missing_primary_fact: addressable unserved-surplus share and causal link to quantity decision
claims.falsifier: dominant waste mechanism lies outside quantity decision

claims.claim: product reduces waste by X percent
claims.falsifier: null/unstable effect, poor measurement, or shortage harm
buyer does not capture avoided-production economics or shortage cost dominates

claims.claim: BUCard turnstile reservation signals equal demand
claims.missing_primary_fact: event semantics, timing, correction and served reconciliation
claims.best_evidence: source owner + data dictionary + aggregate export
claims.falsifier: signal arrives after freeze, is unavailable, or fails reconciliation

claims.missing_primary_fact: existing records adequately measure decision outcome and waste stage
claims.falsifier: existing records cannot establish trustworthy outcome truth

claims.missing_primary_fact: local missing measurement field requiring vision
claims.best_evidence: waste owner + EE/EHB measurement review + incumbent inventory
claims.falsifier: existing records/scales/mature tools suffice or privacy/workflow burden exceeds value
reporting already satisfied and does not alter a decision

claims.missing_primary_fact: software/product buyer, budget, approval path and incentive
claims.best_evidence: procurement owner + SKS approver + contractor decision maker
claims.falsifier: no viable purchase/approval route or split incentives block adoption

claims.claim: contractor is paid per actual served meal
claims.falsifier: payment uses another accepted quantity or fixed commitment
public notice itself frames 5000/day as bidder capacity threshold

claims.claim: same product scales to other universities
claims.falsifier: decision topology requires materially different product/workflow

claims.claim: forecast accuracy is the primary product KPI
claims.missing_primary_fact: link from prediction improvement to approved action and physical outcome
claims.falsifier: higher accuracy does not improve decision/outcome or worsens shortage

claims.claim: external study/vendor effect sizes predict BOUNCAMPUS impact
claims.falsifier: local effect is smaller, absent, or opposite
